summary: A file manager app with folder protection, bulk action bar enhancements, and per-file action menus.
architectural_notes: Bulk action icons (Download All, Favorites All, Shared All, Move All, Delete All) only appear when 2 or more files are selected
Per-file three-dot menu retains: Preview, Rename, Move, Add to Favorites, Delete

existing_features.title: Add five new bulk action icon buttons to the Selection Bulk Action bar in FileList.tsx, placed immediately after the 'Deselect All' button. The five buttons are: (1) Download All, (2) Favorites All, (3) Shared All, (4) Move All, (5) Delete All. All five buttons must be hidden when only 1 file is selected and must only appear when 2 or more files are selected.

Implement the 'Download All' bulk action: when the user clicks Download All with 2+ files selected, trigger a download of each selected file to the user's device using the existing file retrieval mechanism (similar to the single-file download in FilePreview.tsx).

Implement the 'Favorites All' bulk action: when the user clicks Favorites All with 2+ files selected, add all selected files to the Favorites section using the existing favorites mutation hook (useAddToFavorites or equivalent from useQueries.ts).

Implement the 'Shared All' bulk action: when the user clicks Shared All with 2+ files selected, move or mark all selected files as shared using the existing share mutation hooks from useQueries.ts. If sharing requires a recipient or permission selection, open a minimal dialog to collect the required input.

Implement the 'Move All' bulk action: when the user clicks Move All with 2+ files selected, open the existing MoveToFolderDialog (or equivalent) configured to move all selected files to a chosen destination folder using the useMoveFilesToFolder mutation.

Implement the 'Delete All' bulk action: when the user clicks Delete All with 2+ files selected, open a confirmation dialog (reusing or extending DeleteFileDialog/DeleteConfirmationDialog) and upon confirmation, delete all selected files at once using the existing delete mutation hooks.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add 5 bulk action icons (Download All, Favorites All, Shared All, Move All, Delete All) to the Selection Bulk Action bar, visible only when 2+ files are selected, placed after Deselect All icon
